offerings.name: Reader API (s.jina.ai / SERP API)
offerings.pricing: Every request costs a fixed number of tokens, starting from 10,000 tokens；API pricing is based on the token usage（$50/1B tokens = 0.050/1M tokens；$500/11B tokens = 0.045/1M tokens）
offerings.price_basis: Prototype Development 标准 key（10,000 tokens/次 × $0.050/1M tokens 机械换算）
offerings.free_quota: Every new API key comes with 10M free tokens（免费档：10 Million tokens，non-commercial use only, CC-BY-NC）
offerings.output_type: 搜索网页并将前五条结果连同 URL 与内容转换为 LLM-friendly 文本块
offerings.note: 返回 top five results with URLs and contents；Premium key 下限价约 $0.45/1k（0.045/1M tokens）；s.jina.ai 速率：无 key/免费 key 100 RPM，付费 key 1000 RPM。
